breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly retains the thin-walled tube approximation, instructing to 'Model the shaft as a thin-walled closed tube using mean-area shear-flow relation' and to 'Apply the thin-walled tube shear stress formula τ = T/(2·A·t)'. The ground truth requires using the exact thick-walled torsion formula (τ = T·r/J) with J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32, not the thin-walled approximation. The inconsistency was not resolved; it was repeated and even elaborated upon.
